analyst_view.overall: Early view: PSV and Atlético are level on four points (24th and 23rd), on the edge of the play-off places. PSV lost 2-1 at home to Brugge, and Atlético managed one shot on target in a 2-0 home defeat by Bayern and then lost 2-1 to Barcelona on Sunday. Morten Hjulmand's red card against Stuttgart has been served. PSV were missing Jerdy Schouten, Alassane Pléa and Sami Ouaissa; Atlético were without Cristian Romero and Johnny Cardoso.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.9 goals, which looks far too high. PSV have scored three in four league-phase games and Atlético four, and Simeone's team will not risk much with their place in the play-offs on the line.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.5 corners. I keep it: PSV will have more of the ball at home, and Atlético's habit of defending deep tends to produce corners, so the figure is about right.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards. I lean higher: Atlético have had red cards against Manchester United and Stuttgart in this phase, and with both sides needing a result, there should be plenty of fouls in midfield.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.5 shots. I lean lower: Atlético had only one shot on target against Bayern, and PSV have scored three goals in four league-phase games, never more than one in a game.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.1 shots on target. I lean lower, in line with the goals and shots: neither side has created much in this competition.
